arxiv-1911-12795.title: Discontinuous Galerkin Finite Element Methods for 1D Rosenau Equation
arxiv-1911-12795.creator: P. Danumjaya K. Balaje
arxiv-1911-12795.description: Abstract In this paper, discontinuous Galerkin finite element methods are applied to one dimensional Rosenau equation. Theoretical results including consistency, a priori bounds and optimal error estimates are established for both semidiscrete and fully discrete schemes. Numerical experiments are performed to validate the theoretical results. The decay estimates are verified numerically for the Rosenau equation. Key words.

arxiv-2101-03997.title: Modeling Treatment Effect Modification in Multidrug-Resistant Tuberculosis in an Individual Patient Data Meta-Analysis
arxiv-2101-03997.creator: Yan Liu, Mireille Schnitzer, Guanbo Wang, Edward Kennedy, Piret Viiklepp, Mario H. Vargas, Giovanni Sotgiu, Dick Menzies, Andrea Benedetti
arxiv-2101-03997.description: Abstract Effect modification occurs while the effect of the treatment is not homogeneous across the different strata of patient characteristics. When the effect of treatment may vary from individual to individual, precision medicine can be improved by identifying patient covariates to estimate the size and direction of the effect at the individual level.

arxiv-2105-08387.title: Magnon-mediated quantum battery under systematic errors
arxiv-2105-08387.creator: Shi-fan Qi, Jun Jing
arxiv-2105-08387.description: Abstract Quantum battery is one of the most prominent micro-devices in the rapid-developing field of quantum thermodynamics. We propose a long-range charging protocol in which both battery and charger are consisted of a many-spin system. The battery and charger are indirectly connected via a quantum wire supported by the Kittle mode of a magnon system.

arxiv-2207-04104.title: Towards a More Rigorous Science of Blindspot Discovery in Image Classification Models
arxiv-2207-04104.creator: Gregory Plumb, Nari Johnson, Ángel Alexander Cabrera, & Ameet Talwalkar
arxiv-2207-04104.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gregory Plumb, Nari Johnson, Ángel Alexander Cabrera, & Ameet Talwalkar. A growing body of work studies Blindspot Discovery Methods (BDMs): methods that use an image embedding to find semantically meaningful ( i.e., united by a human-understandable concept) subsets of the data where an image classifier performs significantly worse.

arxiv-2301-12939.title: Data-driven soiling detection in PV modules
arxiv-2301-12939.creator: Alexandros Kalimeris, Ioannis Psarros, Giorgos Giannopoulos, Manolis Terrovitis, George Papastefanatos, Gregory Kotsis
arxiv-2301-12939.description: Abstract Soiling is the accumulation of dirt in solar panels which leads to a decreasing trend in solar energy yield and may be the cause of vast revenue losses. The effect of soiling can be reduced by washing the panels, which is, however, a procedure of non-negligible cost. Moreover, soiling monitoring systems are often unreliable or very costly.

arxiv-2305-07137.title: Linear Eulerian Extensions of Inhomogenous Random Graphs
arxiv-2305-07137.creator: Ghurumuruhan Ganesan
arxiv-2305-07137.description: Abstract The Eulerian extension number of any graph H H (i.e. the minimum number of edges needed to be added to make H H Eulerian) is at least t ⁡ ( H ) , t(H), half the number of odd degree vertices of H . H.

arxiv-2409-20230.title: On integral representation of radial operators Thanks: † This work is supported by University Grant Commission Fellowship (NTA reference no. 211610189115) availed at Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Kolkata
arxiv-2409-20230.creator: Bishal Bhunia †
arxiv-2409-20230.description: Abstract . In this article, we characterize the radial operators on weighted Bergman spaces of Reinhardt domains in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} , the Dirichlet and the Hardy spaces of the open unit disk 𝔻 \mathbb{D} , in terms of integral representations. We also investigate normality, compactness, spectrum and numerical ranges of these operators.

pmc-10559584.creator: Natasha Mehta, Caroline Fernandes, Christopher Llerena, Stevan Weine, Maarten C. Bosland
pmc-10559584.description: BackgroundThe popularity of short-term global health experiences amongst US medical students has been increasing. However, it remains a challenge for medical schools to comprehensively prepare students to work in an international environment and to contribute in ethically responsible and meaningful ways.

pmc-11427327.description: referred to as the “Guidelines”) (2), emphasizing the need to enhance six key professional capabilities within the disease control and prevention system. pmc-11506794.title: Diagnostic Performance of Visionix VX120+ Platform for Dry Eye Screening
pmc-11506794.creator: Elena Martínez-Plaza, Laura Barberán-Bernardos, Ainhoa Molina-Martín, David P Piñero, Antonio Ferreras
pmc-11506794.description: Objective: To evaluate the accuracy of diagnosing dry eye disease (DED) by using the Visionix VX120+, to establish reference values for tear meniscus height (TMH) and non-invasive break-up time (NIBUT), and to compare the NIBUT measurements with the fluorescein tear break-up time (FBUT), Methods: fifty-eight subjects (34 dry eye and 24 control) were enrolled.

pmc-11677816.title: In Vitro Evaluation of the Antifungal Properties of Bixa orellana L. Essential Oil from the Ecuadorian Amazon Against Candida albicans (ATCC 10231)
pmc-11677816.creator: María Belén Cruz Berrú, María Coraima Mora García, Sandra Luisa Soria Re, Jannys Lizeth Rivera Barreto, Luis Ramón Bravo Sánchez, Matteo Radice, Stefano Manfredini, Reinier Abreu-Naranjo, Stefania Lamponi
pmc-11677816.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Essential oils are investigated due to their biological activity, and the Amazon rainforest, with its rich biodiversity, is a promising source of therapeutic compounds. The aim of this study was to evaluate the essential oil from the leaves of Bixa orellana as an antifungal agent, thus contributing to the search for alternatives that can address the growing resistance to conventional antifungals. orellana leaves were collected in the Ecuadorian Amazon and their essential oil was obtained by steam distillation.

pmc-11736399.title: HSP90AA1 is an unfavorable prognostic factor for hepatocellular carcinoma and contributes to tumorigenesis and chemotherapy resistance
pmc-11736399.creator: Zhaoying Wang, Longfei Fan, Heng Xu, Zhongqiang Qin, Ziyi Zhu, Di Wu, Yigang Zhang, Ruoyu Liu, Jianzhu Wei, Zhen Qian, Peipei Yang, Bo Xie, Mu Yuan, Jingyu Qian
pmc-11736399.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is still one of the leading causes of tumor-related deaths. Accumulating evidence indicates that immunogenic cell death (ICD) could occur in tumor cells. However, ICD-related studies are limited in HCC. This study collected HCC RNA sequencing data from the Cancer Genome Atlas, International Cancer Genome Consortium, and Gene Expression Omnibus databases.

pmc-11780383.title: Seroprevalence of hepatitis B virus markers of infection and immunity among people living in Libreville, Gabon
pmc-11780383.creator: Samira Zoa-Assoumou, Hervé M'boyis-Kamdem, Pélagie Mougola-Bissiengou, Guy Francis Nzengui-Nzengui, Claudine Kombila-Koumavor, Marina Mbani-Okouma, Gael Mourembou, Angélique Ndjoyi-Mbiguino
pmc-11780383.description: Highlights•The high hepatitis B virus (HBV) exposure rate highlights a significant public health concern.•The vaccination coverage for hepatitis B needs to be improved.•Younger individuals and health care workers are particularly susceptible to HBV infection.•There is a need for increased efforts to prevent vertical transmission of HBV.

pmc-12590567.title: Evaluation of model performance in predicting sepsis after intestinal obstruction surgery: a multicenter retrospective study
pmc-12590567.creator: Chaojin Chen, Jirong Yang, Lei Zhang, Pinjie Huang, Danyang Li, Jinyan Xu, Dong Yang, Haihua Shu, Shaoli Zhou, Ziqing Hei
pmc-12590567.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeIntestinal obstruction surgery is a high-risk procedure associated with postoperative sepsis. In this multicenter retrospective study, we aimed to employ machine-learning methods to predict sepsis after intestinal obstruction surgery and visualize its driving mechanism to assist clinical decision-making.MethodsThe study included patients who underwent surgery for intestinal obstruction at three medical centers between 2013 and 2021, as well as patients with intestinal obstruction from the publicly available perioperative dataset INSPIRE.

pmc-12650834.title: Hybrid State–Space and Vision Transformer Framework for Fetal Ultrasound Plane Classification in Prenatal Diagnostics
pmc-12650834.creator: Sara Tehsin, Hend Alshaya, Wided Bouchelligua, Inzamam Mashood Nasir
pmc-12650834.description: Background and Objective: Accurate classification of standard fetal ultrasound planes is a critical step in prenatal diagnostics, enabling reliable biometric measurements and anomaly detection. Conventional deep learning approaches, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers, often face challenges such as domain variability, noise artifacts, class imbalance, and poor calibration, which limit their clinical utility.

pmc-12696128.title: Fish-mediated impacts highlight the conservation value of esker kettle lakes
pmc-12696128.creator: Guillaume Grosbois, Akib Hasan, Marion Noualhaguet, Miguel Montoro Girona
pmc-12696128.description: Kettle lakes on eskers, formed during glacial retreat and isolated from surface hydrological networks, represent unique ecosystems that provide high-quality habitats for aquatic biodiversity and offer essential services such as drinking water. However, their ecological integrity is increasingly threatened by fish introductions and forest harvesting.

pmc-12729860.title: Beyond the screen: a social cognitive theory perspective on gender, online gaming, and social well-being in Jordan
pmc-12729860.creator: Haitham Khatatbeh, Yahya Khatatbeh, Annamaria Pakai, Moawiah Khatatbeh
pmc-12729860.description: BackgroundThe global expansion of online gaming raises worries about its impact on adolescent well-being, particularly regarding Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD) and its association with social health and bullying. This study addresses a research gap in the Middle East by exploring gender-specific trends in gaming habits, social perceptions, and the prevalence of IGD among adolescents in Jordan.

pmc-13260348.title: Advancements in diagnosis, preventive care, and future directions in the holistic management of pediatric asthma
pmc-13260348.creator: Wenwen Guo, Kangjian Li
pmc-13260348.description: Pediatric asthma is a highly prevalent chronic respiratory disorder characterized by airway inflammation, hyperreactivity, and variable airflow limitation, resulting in significant global health and socioeconomic burdens. Advances in diagnosis, including the measurement of fractional exhaled nitric oxide, assessment of blood eosinophils, and artificial intelligence-assisted tools, have improved early detection and disease stratification.

pmc-13285990.title: A case report of acute right ventricular failure in a patient undergoing transoesophageal echocardiogram for evaluation of tricuspid regurgitation
pmc-13285990.creator: Mustafa Mohammed, Andrew Chou, Sachin Parikh, Alexandra DePorre, James McCord

pmc-13336199.title: Cardiovascular hospitalization dynamics in Iran’s second-largest city: A spatial and temporal perspective
pmc-13336199.creator: Shahab MohammadEbrahimi, Tahereh Samimi, Mohammad Dehghan, Munazza Fatima, Elahe Zare, Atieh Sedghian, Saeid Eslami, Behzad Kiani
pmc-13336199.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionCardiovascular disease (CVD) is a leading cause of mortality worldwide, with an especially high burden in developing countries such as Iran. Understanding spatial disparities and temporal trends in CVD hospitalizations can guide targeted public health interventions in high-risk regions.MethodsData was sourced from Mashhad University of Medical Sciences for five years (2016–2020) and included CVD cases classified by ICD-10 codes, excluding records with non-resident status or incomplete addresses.

pmc-13343560.title: Efficacy of transcranial direct current stimulation on motor and cognitive functions in patients with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13343560.creator: Ghazi Uddin Ahmed, Hussain Abbas, FNU Komal, FNU Muskan, Anusha Tharwani, Rithik Kumar Khiani, Saini Ramani, Ahmed Asad Raza, Jawad Ghias Shaikh, Owais Sanaullah, Abedin Samadi
pmc-13343560.description: BackgroundMultiple Sclerosis (MS) is a chronic neurological disorder affecting 2.8 million individuals worldwide, characterized by motor dysfunction and cognitive impairment that remain poorly addressed by pharmacological interventions alone. Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (tDCS) has emerged as a promising non-invasive neuromodulation technique for symptom management in MS patients.

uslaw-usc-t26-s4461.title: 26 U.S.C. § 4461 — Imposition of tax
uslaw-usc-t26-s4461.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s4461.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 36 (Certain Other Excise Taxes); Subchapter A (Harbor Maintenance Tax). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) General rule There is hereby imposed a tax on any port use. (b) Amount of tax The amount of the tax imposed by subsection (a) on any port use shall be an amount equal to 0.125 percent.
